parsed.explanation: A small-island jurisdiction with no trans-specific offence, no facility or custody restrictions, and no documented police targeting of trans people; the only trans-specific legal finding is the absence of gender-identity protection, which is a resident gap, not visitor exposure (rule 1). The worst documented item is dated (2006 parade bar) plus organised religious hostility aimed at couples read as same-sex — a secondary factor that reaches trans visitors in relationships but is social hostility, not state threat-framing (tier 3 at most). Thin data: recognition of foreign markers, custody, and facilities are open questions, not exposures. No documented acceptance tradition to offset the religious constituency and inequality residue, so the score sits in elevated-to-reduced territory: friction and thin recourse with no known traveller-facing restriction.
